posts.text: “Good morning. It’s Monday. I am traumatized. I came in thru the front door and Chester came in too! He then swiped at me! Zoë growled. Thumb guy yelled. I will need time to process. Also, I love you.”
I don’t want to be awake right now.

Man do I wish I had more confidence that the Trump administration would oppose and condemn Orban if he tries to steal a legitimate election. Not predicting anything, just don’t trust Orban not to try and don’t trust Trump and Vance to do the right thing.

(Some) Treaties do expire. JCPOA wasn’t a treaty though. At least that’s what you guys insisted at the time.


Tommy Vietor (@TVietor08)

This is the dumbest of many dumb talking points. Treaties expire so you renegotiate. That’s diplomacy. Arms control agreements with Russia were iterative & renegotiated many times. The alternative is what’s happening now—a catastrophic war pushed by chickenhawks neocons like Mark
